game.name: Super Mario Galaxy 2
game.rules:
**Game Restrictions and Recommendations:**

- The game **must** be played on an authentic disc, Wii U Virtual Console, or an allowed emulator. Loading the game through USB, Neogamma, NVIDIA Shield or any other means is **banned**.
- Game hacks, cheat codes (such as Gecko codes), custom textures, and other unofficial game modifications or releases are **banned** unless stated otherwise.
- Manipulating your Wii’s save data to skip the save textbox is **banned**.
- 2P/Co-Star runs are allowed, however multiplayer runs are **banned**.
- For Green star runs, you may use a completed file found in the Resources tab.
- You may use Gecko to play discs from other regions on Wii or Virtual Wii.
- You may use any homebrew software, such as Mocha, Haxchi, Tiramisu, or Aroma, to install the game on the Wii U Virtual Console.

**Submission Restrictions and Recommendations:**

- The **entire** run should have video and audio. Runs suffering from technical issues, such as stream crashes, may be given some leniency. Submissions **must** include the beginning and end of the run.
- Runs **must** be completed in a single segment (RTA). If you pause the timer, your run will be retimed.
- Please trim the submission video close to the beginning of the run or include a timestamp in the submission’s description.
- Twitch past broadcasts, Twitch highlights, and any download links will be **rejected**; we recommend submitting your runs via YouTube videos.
- Select the appropriate date, platform, and game region. Runs completed on Wii U using a disc should be submitted under “Wii” and not “Wii U VC.”
- Exclude milliseconds in full-game run submissions. World RTAs, All Star runs, Normal Star runs, and Single Star runs **must** include milliseconds. Please use [vidtimer](https://vidtimer.com/) to retime your runs.
- If 2P/Co-Star mode was activated intentionally and used to save any time, please select “2P” under “Mode.” If 2P was activated accidentally but never used to save time, you may select “1P.” In this case, please timestamp where 2P was activated. Moderators will decide if the run used 1P or 2P if it’s not clear.

**Emulator Restrictions:**

- **Any** of the [released Dolphin emulator versions](https://dolphin-emu.org/download/?ref=btn) and [Lua Dolphin](https://github.com/MikeXander/Dolphin-Lua-Core) are the **only** permitted emulators. Development versions of Dolphin and any other emulators are **banned**.
- You **must** have FPS shown, either in the title bar or overlaid on the game itself.

- You **must** show the Dolphin version at some point in the video. This can be shown after the run for convenience.
- The "speed up disc transfer rate" or "emulate disc speed" option **must** be unchecked or set to undetermined (-) and **must** be shown at some point in the video. This may be shown after the run for convenience. **Every** type of run **needs** to show this option, **except** for single star runs.
- The game **must** be running at 60 frames per second. Higher frame rates are **banned**. Occasional frame drops or lag spikes are acceptable but runs that have **significant frame drops** or heavy lag **may be rejected**.
- You may use any controller, including a keyboard and mouse. **All** runs that specifically use a keyboard and mouse **must** show a visual input display. **Any other controllers are exempt from this rule**.
- Runs recorded through Dolphin’s movie recording feature will be **rejected**.
- Save states are **banned.** They may be used outside of runs to reset or practice.
- Slowing down the game intentionally is **banned**.
- Decreasing load times intentionally is **banned**.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
**Objective:**

- From a new file, beat the game by collecting the grand star in Bowser’s Galaxy Generator.

**Timing:**

- Time begins on the first frame “Start” turns light blue upon selecting it and ends on the first frame the grand star cutscene begins upon collecting it in Bowser’s Galaxy Generator.

**Banktoad:**

- For “With Bank” runs, you may fill Banktoad’s inventory from another file before the run and withdraw Star Bits during the run.
- For “Restricted Bank” runs, the 100 Star Bits that Banktoad starts with may be withdrawn during the run. Transferring Star Bits from another file using Banktoad is **banned**.

categories.name: 242 Stars
categories.rules:
**Objective:**

- From a new file, obtain 242 stars.

**Timing:**

- Time begins on the first frame “Start” turns light blue upon selecting it and ends on the first frame the star cutscene begins upon collecting the last star in The Perfect Run.

**Banktoad:**

- For “With Bank” runs, you can have a file that has already obtained 242 stars, making the Grandmaster’s Prankster Comet appear without requiring Banktoad to be full. You may fill Banktoad’s inventory from another file before the run and withdraw Star Bits during the run.
- For “Restricted Bank” runs, you **must** begin with **no** previous file data present. The 100 Star Bits that Banktoad starts with may be withdrawn during the run. Transferring Star Bits from another file using Banktoad is **banned**.

**Break:**

- A **single break that lasts up to 30 minutes is permitted at any point** in the run. This break begins the first frame the HOME menu is opened and ends upon the first frame the HOME menu is closed. If the break is longer than 30 minutes, any additional time will be added to the run’s final time. A break will only be **allowed** for the "242 Stars" leaderboard. If you submit a portion of a 242 star run to “Any%,” “120 Stars,” or “Green Stars” that contains a break, the break time **will be** included in those submissions. Please timestamp your break in the submission’s description.

categories.name: 120 Stars
categories.rules:
**Objective:**

- From a new file, obtain 120 stars, then collect the grand star in Bowser’s Galaxy Generator a second time.

**Timing:**

- Time begins on the first frame “Start” turns light blue upon selecting it and ends on the first frame the grand star cutscene begins upon collecting it with 120 stars obtained in Bowser’s Galaxy Generator.

categories.name: All Stars
categories.rules:
**Objective:**

- Obtain all stars in a galaxy. You may use a completed file to skip cutscenes.

**Timing:**

- Time begins on the first frame player one’s pointer disappears upon selecting a star and ends on the first frame the star cutscene begins upon collecting the last star in the galaxy.

categories.name: Normal Stars
categories.rules:
**Objective:**

- Obtain all normal stars in a galaxy. You may use a completed file to skip cutscenes.

**Timing:**

- Time begins on the first frame player one’s pointer disappears upon selecting a star and ends on the first frame the star cutscene begins upon collecting the last normal star in the galaxy.

categories.name: Green Stars
categories.rules:
**Objective:**

- Obtain all green stars in a galaxy. You may use a completed file to skip cutscenes.

**Timing:**

- Time begins on the first frame player one’s pointer disappears upon selecting a star and ends on the first frame the star cutscene begins upon collecting the last star in the galaxy.

categories.name: Green Stars
categories.rules:
**Objective:**

- From a completed 120 star file, obtain 120 green stars. You may use a file with maximum Star Bits and coins to skip post-level notifications.

**Timing:**

- Time begins on the first frame “Start” turns light blue upon selecting it and ends on the first frame the green star cutscene begins upon collecting the last star.

categories.name: Single Star
categories.rules:
**Objective:**

- Obtain a star. You **must** show the in-game timer after obtaining the star. You may use a completed file to skip cutscenes.

**Timing:**

- Follow the in-game timer.

**Mods:**

- You may use [this mod](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/118130425804750851/1304233984385093672/SMG2RestartStagev2NoSyati.zip?ex=674f9b8d&is=674e4a0d&hm=6d5aca9fdb5755abac1f81f23a9062faaa3c28ec2d4b18ea7b77399cc26a57f2&) to facilitate resets. Any other game modifications are **banned**.

levels.name: World RTA
levels.rules:
**World RTA Objective:**

- Obtain **all** stars in a world. You may use a completed file to skip cutscenes.

**World RTA Timing:**

- Time begins on the first frame player one’s pointer disappears upon selecting a star and ends on the first frame the star cutscene begins upon collecting the last star in the world.

this is me eating plant

Promising run! Jumped up two places back to 6th and have plenty of potential to go for a 2:57 short term and hopefully WR long term.

Deaths: 3

Lava Lair 1 (45:49) - Went for the jump to the Bowser door too early. Combined with slow movement earlier in the level, lost roughly 20s.

Flipsville 1 (1:22:12) - Dodgy angle while attempting the skip to Glamdozer, didn't have enough speed. lost roughly 45 seconds.

Galaxy Generator (2:53:50) - Had too little speed during the flutter for a number of reasons, lost roughly 45 seconds to the death. (Heartbreaking)

Other notable time losses: Gravity Gauntlet 1, Boulder Bowl 1, Throwback 1

2:57 very soon

It has been a while, ever since my first sub 3 choke it looked like i just couldn't do it, and im really glad that happened instead of a massive fluke because thanks to that my movement and confidence with the game has increased by a massive amount, i learned new stuff that will be useful in the near future and i can say that i truly deserved getting this time

But well, lets go over some possible improvements:

from w1 to 3 i have close to nothing, only 15 to boulder bowl 1 and no qbf in fearsome fleet 1 (which only lost 5 lol)

w4 was pretty silly, bled some time over the whole segment but the big timeloss was getting itc 3rd try, losing me around 30 to my btc gold

w5 had some cringe things like 12 to flip swap C and 10 to space storm 1 but overall solid

w6 well, not great but what can you expect, the nerves are strong getting here on such a pace, everything felt very sloppy even with all the golds that i got, biggest timeloss was 20 to ggen to a gold that i already know i can improve. I will also start doing ggC itc if i ever grind this category again (i will most likely do it) so that's another 15ish i can save to my gold
